newsitem.title: USA: Anti-abortion activist tries to burn Calif. clinic.
newsitem.headline: Anti-abortion activist tries to burn Calif. clinic.

text.p: An anti-abortion activist crashed a pickup truck loaded with propane tanks and gasoline cans into a family planning clinic Monday in a failed attempt to destroy it, police said.
Police allege that Peter Howard, a 44-year-old registered nurse, crashed his truck through the glass front of the clinic, where abortions are performed, in Bakersfield early Monday morning.

Howard, who was wearing a crash helmet and ear plugs, allegedly got out of the vehicle after the crash and set fire to the back of the truck with a butane lighter before walking away, Bakersfield police spokesman Sgt. Bill Henry said.
The back of the truck contained three five-gallon propane tanks and 11 five-gallon cans containing gasoline as well as newspapers, Henry said.

A private security guard detained Howard near the scene and turned him over to police, Henry said. The fire department responded quickly and put out the fire in the pickup truck without any explosion. The building was empty at the time and no one was injured, Henry said.
The blaze was "pretty much contained to the truck", although the pickup seriously damaged the glass front of the building, he said.

"Had it ignited the way it was intended, our bomb technicians are telling us the explosion would have destroyed at the very least half of the building and fire would have taken the rest of it," Henry said.
Howard, a Bakersfield resident, told police he had been an anti-abortion demonstrator for many years, Henry said.
Henry said Howard told investigators his intent was to destroy the building. "He felt that he would be protecting the children by doing so," he said.

Henry said Howard would likely be charged under state laws with attempting to set off an explosive device and using an explosive against an abortion clinic. He said Howard could face up to 15 years in prison if convicted.
